# Grace Technologies

> A UK-led technology and digital engineering partner delivering enterprise Website Development, AI Automation, Merchant Account Management, and Digital Marketing (SEO/GEO/AEO) solutions for growing businesses.

Website: https://www.gracetechnologies.uk
Headquarters: 398 Whalebone Lane South, Romford, Greater London, RM6 6HP, United Kingdom
Contact: contact@gracetechnologies.uk | +44 7407 268125
Technology Delivery Partner: Ank Square Pvt. Ltd., Patna, Bihar, India (contact@anksquare.com)

---

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Website Development
- URL: https://www.gracetechnologies.uk/services/website-development
- Architecture: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Edge API routes, Turbopack
- Core Specialisms:
  - Custom full-stack web applications and client portals
  - E-commerce stores with sub-second page performance
  - B2B enterprise websites engineered for conversion rate optimisation (CRO)
  - Strict Core Web Vitals compliance (LCP <= 2.5s, INP <= 200ms, CLS <= 0.1)
  - Technical SEO, JSON-LD Schema.org architecture, and mobile-first responsive UX

### 2. AI Automation & Intelligent Agents
- URL: https://www.gracetechnologies.uk/services/ai-automation
- Core Specialisms:
  - Autonomous AI agent workflows and task orchestration
  - LLM tool-calling, RAG pipelines, and deterministic business rules
  - Enterprise CRM/ERP automations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, custom databases)
  - Intelligent customer support chatbots and automated lead qualification
  - Document processing, OCR, and invoice automation pipelines

### 3. Merchant Account Management & Payment Operations
- URL: https://www.gracetechnologies.uk/services/merchant-account-management
- Core Specialisms:
  - Merchant onboarding assistance and acquiring bank underwriting compliance
  - Multi-currency payment gateway integrations (Stripe, Worldpay, Adyen, PayPal)
  - Chargeback reduction protocols and 3D Secure 2.3 frictionless checkout
  - Interchange fee optimisation and settlement timeline acceleration

### 4. Digital Marketing, SEO, GEO & AEO
- URL: https://www.gracetechnologies.uk/services/digital-marketing
- Core Specialisms:
  - Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) for ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude
  - Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) for Google Featured Snippets and AI Overviews
  - Technical and organic B2B Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
  - Hyper-local SEO for Greater London, Essex, and nationwide UK commercial hubs
  - Conversion rate optimisation (CRO) and privacy-compliant analytics

---

## Bilateral Operating Model

Grace Technologies operates a bilateral technology delivery alliance:
- **UK Entity (Grace Technologies)**: Commercial leadership, client relationship management, requirements architecture, British corporate governance, and executive SLA oversight.
- **India Delivery Partner (Ank Square Pvt. Ltd.)**: Dedicated engineering delivery center in India providing high-velocity full-stack Next.js development, AI pipeline engineering, and technical maintenance.
- **Client Benefit**: UK legal governance and timezone advisory combined with high-impact engineering bandwidth and competitive pricing.
